title: A binary matrix with nonzero small subset sums
statement: Let $k,\ell,n$ be natural numbers with $1\le k$, $1\le\ell$, $n=2^\ell$, and $k\le n$. There is a matrix over $\mathbb F_2$ with $(k-1)\ell+1$ rows and $n$ columns such that the sum of the columns in every nonempty subset of at most $k$ columns is nonzero.
